mda.name: Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board
mda.description: JAMB registration and post-registration services reconstructed from official JAMB payment and service material, the 2026 bulletin and the 2025 training manual.

officialChannels.name: JAMB e-Facility
officialChannels.instructions: Use JAMB e-Facility for the service route stated by JAMB. CBT centre charges and other third-party charges remain separate from JAMB fees.

officialChannels.name: JAMB Payment & Services
officialChannels.instructions: Consult the official JAMB payment and services list for service and separately stated CBT charges.

jamb-local-payment-services.title: JOINT ADMISSIONS AND MATRICULATION BOARD — PAYMENT & SERVICES
jamb-local-payment-services.documentReference: Local evidence copy: research/repo/JAMB_PAYMENT & SERVICES.pdf, 1 page. Its browser capture metadata shows 31 October 2026; this is not treated as a publication or effective date.
jamb-local-payment-services.notes: Full one-page source lists JAMB fees and separately lists CBT service charges. Absence of a fee on this page is not evidence that a service is free.

jamb-2026-bulletin.title: JAMB Bulletin, Volume 4 No. 74, 2 March 2026
jamb-2026-bulletin.documentReference: Archived repository copy: research/evidence/archive/jamb/JAMBulletin_02-03-2026.pdf, 31 pages; registration fees in pp. 5-6 and 27.
jamb-2026-bulletin.notes: States Direct Entry ₦5,700; UTME without mock ₦7,200; UTME with mock ₦8,700. Its fee breakdown separately itemises application fee, reading text, CBT centre charges and bank charges.

jamb-2025-training-manual.title: Manual for Officials of 2025 UTME
jamb-2025-training-manual.documentReference: Archived repository copy: research/evidence/archive/jamb/2025_TRAINING_MANUAL_final.pdf, 142 pages. PDF metadata creation date is 4 April 2025 and is not asserted as publication date.
jamb-2025-training-manual.notes: Operational and registration guidance, including a 2025 registration fee breakdown and separate CBT/bank charges. The online-service fee table on printed p. 100 lists coloured result-slip printing with its portal charge and separate centre charges.

jamb-official-portal.title: JAMB Portal — Print Result Slip
jamb-official-portal.documentReference: Official JAMB portal service label and ₦1,500 amount supplied for this reconciliation.
jamb-official-portal.notes: Portal corroborates the ₦1,500 Print Result Slip amount. It does not resolve the conflict with the Payment & Services listing; no separate centre charge is inferred from this portal evidence.

jamb-payment-services-existing-record.title: JAMB official payment services page — existing repository evidence record
jamb-payment-services-existing-record.documentReference: Existing Batch 2 JAMB evidence record; JAMB Result Slip ₦1,000 plus separate ₦100 CBT service charge.
jamb-payment-services-existing-record.notes: Retained as previously recorded evidence for the result-slip conflict. The local one-page source independently shows the same service and separate charge.

services.name: Printing of result slip
services.description: Result-slip printing service with conflicting official JAMB amounts.
services.paymentGuide: Official JAMB sources list different result-slip charges. Confirm the applicable current amount through JAMB before payment; CBT/centre service charges remain separate from the portal charge.
services.notes: Do not present a single authoritative fee until the conflict is resolved. Payment & Services lists JAMB Result Slip ₦1,000 plus separate CBT charge ₦100. The 2025 Training Manual printed p. 100 lists coloured result-slip portal charge ₦1,500, PRC/PTC service charge ₦200 or non-JAMB centre service charge ₦300. The JAMB portal also lists Print Result Slip ₦1,500. All portal/JAMB amounts and centre charges remain separate.

feeOptions.conditions: Payment & Services page value; CBT service charge ₦100 separately listed.
feeOptions.label: Result slip (Payment & Services listing)
feeOptions.notes: JAMB amount; CBT charge excluded. Conflict retained.
feeOptions.evidenceNote: JAMB RESULT SLIP: ₦1,000; CBT SERVICE CHARGE: ₦100 separately listed.

feeOptions.conditions: 2025 Training Manual printed p. 100: coloured result-slip portal charge; separate service charge ₦200 at PRC/PTC or ₦300 at non-JAMB centres.
feeOptions.label: Printing of Result Slip (Coloured) — 2025 manual
feeOptions.notes: Portal charge ₦1,500. PRC/PTC and non-JAMB centre service charges are separate and excluded.
feeOptions.evidenceNote: The manual table states Printing of Result Slip (Coloured), Portal Charge ₦1,500, Service Charge at PRC/PTC ₦200 (₦300 for non-JAMB Centres). JAMB portal corroborates a Print Result Slip amount of ₦1,500.
